data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (World Bank → Wikipedia → compose email with the macro snapshot subject and body) and parameterizes country and recipient, but it misses the scroll to the GDP growth section, treats the recipient as a full email plus a separate name instead of a single client parameter, and ends with "send or discard" where the true workflow says never send and always discard, so an automation would be mostly buildable but ambiguous at the end.
